name: ES Volume-Time Geodesic Bow v1
instrument: ES continuous front-month signal with one MES execution unit
hypothesis: An auction can be parameterized by cumulative volume rather than clock time. Relative to the straight minimum-action path connecting the opening price and final opening-auction price, the signed volume-weighted bow of actual prices reveals which side absorbed inventory before the endpoint was established. Price should subsequently move away from the bowed side.

construction.volume_coordinate_for_each_minute: cumulative volume before the minute plus one-half of that minute's volume, divided by total opening volume
construction.geodesic_price: start price plus volume coordinate times (end price minus start price)
construction.bow_score: sum(volume * (typical price - geodesic price)) divided by total opening volume
construction.zero_rule: no trade when bow score equals zero
construction.interpretation: a negative bow means inventory accumulated below the endpoint-consistent path before price recovered; a positive bow is the symmetric case

execution.entry: 10:00 open plus one adverse ES tick
execution.stop_fill: one adverse ES tick beyond the applicable opening extreme
execution.entry_validity: skip if the frozen stop fill is not adverse to the simulated entry
execution.same_bar_rule: if the 10:00 entry bar touches the stop trigger, assume the stop fills
execution.gap_through_rule: if a stop bar opens beyond the trigger, fill at the worse bar open plus one adverse tick; otherwise fill at the frozen stop price
execution.survivor_exit: 15:30 open plus one adverse ES tick
execution.position_limit: one MES and at most one trade per RTH session

lesson: The signed volume-time bow contained weak aggregate information, especially for shorts after 2021, but it failed 2021 and the long side. Neither the side asymmetry nor a direction reversal can be selected. The original geometric construction is rejected unchanged.
holdout_policy: 2024-2025 was not evaluated because the unchanged rule failed its development gates.
prohibited_posthoc_changes: negating the bow direction after observing results
using closes, midpoints, or another price instead of typical price
adding a bow-magnitude or endpoint-move threshold
weekday, volatility, volume, or regime filters
changing the stop or exit after observing results
